result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection equipped with sidewalks and a marked crosswalk, though the pavement within the intersection is significantly degraded. While traffic signals are present, there is a lack of visible pedestrian-specific signal heads, and the crosswalk markings are of a low-visibility design.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The intersection surface is heavily patched and uneven, creating trip hazards for pedestrians and potential loss of control for vehicles.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: While traffic lights are present, there are no visible pedestrian-specific signal heads to indicate when it is safe to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Signal poles at the intersection corners

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Resurface the intersection to provide a smooth, predictable surface for all users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace the existing parallel line crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings to increase driver awareness.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a signalized intersection with marked ladder-style crosswalks and a dedicated bus stop with a shelter. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and pedestrian signals are present, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures increase exposure for crossing pedestrians.

hazards.name: Wide crossing distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway at the intersection, including the bus stop area, increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of physical buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the travel lane with no physical barrier or significant buffer zone.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line near the bus stop

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light to reduce conflicts with turning traffic.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with row houses, featuring a signalized crossing with marked crosswalks and sidewalks. While basic infrastructure exists, the crosswalk markings are faded and there are no dedicated pedestrian signals or modern safety features like curb extensions.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted lines for the crosswalk are worn and faded, making the crossing less visible to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: There are no visible pedestrian signal heads, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk using a high-visibility 'continental' pattern to increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve predictability and safety for people crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks and signals within a mixed-use urban environment. However, the lack of physical traffic calming and the presence of parked vehicles near crossing points increase pedestrian exposure and reduce visibility.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners may obstruct the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sides of the main street near the crosswalks.

hazards.name: Pedestrian Exposure
hazards.description: The wide intersection lacks physical refuge, leaving pedestrians exposed to traffic for the entire crossing duration.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.
